body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #3, company drawn at random from the cheapest EV/EBITDA tercile (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.4 (naive base rate 0.44) that: Automotive Axles price return beats the Nifty 500 from 23-Nov-2026 to 30-Sep-2027. Our reasoning: The window ends ~5 months after the regulatory pre-buy ends (April 2027); CV ancillaries usually de-rate into a volume turn; the low starting P/E (12.9x) and net cash limit the damage. Naive base: share of small caps beating the index over ~10 months, skewed below 0.5 [EST, as in live deep dive #1]. Resolution: YES if AUTOAXLES.NS close on 30-Sep-2027 / 1,776.30 (close 23-Nov-2026) > ^CRSLDX close on 30-Sep-2027 / 23,748.15 (close 23-Nov-2026); price return, last close on or before 30-Sep-2027. Source: Yahoo v8 daily closes (AUTOAXLES.NS, ^CRSLDX); NSE bhavcopy. Resolve by 2027-09-30; score with Brier vs the base rate.
